channel.title: Knowledge Recorder Updates
channel.description: Signed macOS updates for Knowledge Recorder.

item.description:
## Knowledge Recorder 1.1.77
- **Brain history and new versions:** the brain button in the media viewer lists every send with date, time, knowledge area, version and state. After changing an image, "Send new version…" sends it as an additional "(Version 2)" document — the earlier one stays in the Brain.

## Knowledge Recorder 1.1.76
- **Media Library to the Brain:** send screenshots and screen recordings to a knowledge area of the Corporate Digital Brain with the company login — right-click an item › "Send to Brain…" or select several and click "Send to Brain". An icon next to the date shows the processing state. - **Large videos in parts:** videos above 95 MB are uploaded in parts and continue after a lost connection or quitting the app.

Company sign-in for the Corporate Digital Brain on macOS and Windows.
## macOS
- **Company sign-in for the Brain:** Settings › Cloud & Accounts signs in with your Microsoft company account in the browser; the Brain confirms who you are. Your knowledge areas come from your own permissions and notes upload to the area you choose. The API key remains available as an alternative. - **One setup package for the whole team:** packages carry the Brain address and settings but no personal access; after the import the app offers the company sign-in. - **Readable knowledge-area names** in the note header picker. - **Help:** company sign-in and setup packages, German and English.
## Windows
- **Company sign-in for the Brain:** the same sign-in through the default browser; your knowledge areas appear in Settings and in the note header. The API key remains available as an alternative. - **One setup package for the whole team:** packages carry the Brain address and settings but no personal access; the end of the import offers the company sign-in. - **Readable knowledge-area names** in the note header picker. - **Help:** new "Send to Corporate Digital Brain" section plus setup-package guidance, German and English.
